name: Garden Gingdom
storyline:
A peculiar kingdom ruled by a king his named King Ging whose obsession with ginseng has long crossed into madness. (The pun is absolutely intentional.)

His Majesty has decreed that the kingdom’s iconic potion shop must become the envy of every neighboring land. And of course, its only power source? The mystical roots of ginseng.

Unfortunately, the last manager of the shop… left under rather strange circumstances. Rumor has it they mistook garlic for ginseng—an unforgivable crime! And by a twist of fate, you are now the newly appointed manager of this prestigious potion shop. Congratulations—you’re officially doomed!

Your first day begins with a warm welcome from the shop’s ever-sarcastic alchemist, who greets you with:

“Oh look, another useless manager. Just what we needed.”

But don’t worry! You’ve got ambition, determination, and a healthy fear of unemployment. Your mission is clear: manage the shop, cultivate magical herbs, brew wondrous potions, and fulfill King Ging’s increasingly eccentric demands.
summary: Garden Gingdom is a single-player, fantasy, resource management game where you brew potions, craft magical items, and serve them in time to your customers in a fast-paced environment.
